correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all hypotheses and quantified the normalization and fixed-start J1 convergence. By symmetry the rescaled drift and continuous covariance vanish. The jump compensator is n*b_n^(-alpha)*gamma*|y|^(-d-alpha). Laplace Morse asymptotics yield C_* with factor (2*pi*alpha0)^(d/2), each inverse-square-root Hessian and stationary density. Uniform exponential TV mixing gives mean-square triangular-array averaging error O((log n)^d/n). Test-function jump and modified second characteristics converge; the cited semimartingale criterion yields the functional Levy limit. One-time sharpness uses tightness and nonatomic stable marginals. The 95 deterministic verification checks corroborate the integral coefficient, not the infinite theorem. No external mathematical audit performed.

originality.rationale: The source arXiv:2610.30342v1, Sections 2–3 and final open problem, has a vanishing limit at the ordinary n^(1/alpha0) scale for measure-zero minima and does not provide a nondegenerate logarithmically corrected spatial functional limit. The present finite-Morse-minimum result specifies its scaling and stable intensity. Published time-periodic additive-process Laplace asymptotics (Kuhwald–Pavlyukevich 2016) explain why isolated minima lead to logarithmic factors but concern a different driving model and metastable exit problem. Franke 2006 was accessible only as abstract and presents an unresolved historical-priority risk. Searches found no equivalent claim; this is a qualified assessment, not global uniqueness certification.
